requirement.description: The flask hook is not correctly detecting and hooking Flask applications created in test modules. The hook_flask function fails to properly identify Flask app instances that are dynamically created within test modules, resulting in server-side HTTP requests not being recorded.
requirement.contract: The hook_flask function must properly detect Flask app instances created in test modules by checking for Flask-specific attributes (route, view_functions, error_handlers) and hook all view functions and error handlers associated with those apps. The function should work with Flask apps created in test modules and properly integrate with the test execution environment.

requirement.description: The generic hook mechanism doesn't properly handle Flask app detection when Flask apps are created dynamically within test modules. It's not recognizing Flask app instances that are created inline within test functions rather than imported from modules.
requirement.contract: The hook_generic function must properly identify Flask app instances regardless of where they are defined (imported modules vs. inline in test functions). It should detect Flask apps by checking for Flask-specific attributes and hook their view functions and error handlers accordingly.
